definitions.short: properly, to be (or make ) bare ; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense)
definitions.usage: × very, beware, take crafty (counsel), be prudent, deal subtilly.
definitions.full: H6191. arom [ עָרֹם Lag BN 31 ] verb be shrewd, crafty (Late Hebrew id. , Hiph`il; Arabic , , be ill-natured, cross ; ᵑ7 adjective עָרִים shrewd , Syriac id. , and verb in derived species (Pe`al in Lexicons)); — Qal Infinitive absolute in יַעְרִם עָרֹם 1Sam 23:22 he is exceedingly crafty . Hiph`il Imperfect be crafty , 3 masculine singular יַעְרִם 1Sam 23:22 ; be or become shrewd יַעְרִם Prov 15:5 ; 19:25 ; all these Qal Imperfect in ִ֯ according to Ba ZMG xliii (1889), 180 so Ges § 63n Buhl Lex , but perhaps read יֶעְרַם as Qal ; True. Hiph`il in 3 masculine plural סוֺד יַעֲרִימוּ Psa 83:4 they make crafty (their) counsel against thy people.
